name: Insulated Sub-Dermal Vest
description: Light fabric armor padded with gel to absorb kinetic impact and insulate against cold. AC: 11 + Dex modifier. Light armor. Stealth: disadvantage.

name: Kevlar Street Jacket
description: Flexible leather-style jacket reinforced with internal Kevlar weave for discreet protection. AC: 11 + Dex modifier. Light armor. No Stealth penalty.

name: Reinforced Ballistic Weave
description: A heavy leather jacket studded with titanium plates and ballistic fiber for street combat. AC: 12 + Dex modifier. Light armor. No Stealth penalty.

name: Chitinous Mutated-Critter Leather
description: Tough armor crafted from the thick hides of mutated beasts harvested in Sector 17. AC: 12 + Dex modifier (max +2). Medium armor. No Stealth penalty.

name: Flexible Carbon-Chain Weave
description: A lightweight shirt of interlocking carbon-fiber rings worn under street clothes. AC: 13 + Dex modifier (max +2). Medium armor. No Stealth penalty.

name: Tactical Chain Mesh
description: A full suit of flexible steel-mesh armor designed to stop edged weapons and fragmentation. AC: 16 (Dex modifier not added). Heavy armor. Stealth: disadvantage. Requires Strength 13 or your speed drops by 10 ft.

name: Industrial Composite Mesh
description: A heavy ring-mail suit designed for industrial workers and heavy security guards. AC: 14 (Dex modifier not added). Heavy armor. Stealth: disadvantage.

name: Overlapping Composite Plate Vest
description: A vest featuring overlapping ceramic scales that absorb kinetic and thermal strikes. AC: 14 + Dex modifier (max +2). Medium armor. Stealth: disadvantage.

name: Articulated Alloy Armor
description: Heavy armor made of metal strips riveted together to shield vital organs without restricting movement. AC: 17 (Dex modifier not added). Heavy armor. Stealth: disadvantage. Requires Strength 15 or your speed drops by 10 ft.

name: Titanium Chest Rig
description: A molded metal plate covering the torso to protect the heart and lungs from high-caliber fire. AC: 14 + Dex modifier (max +2). Medium armor. No Stealth penalty.

name: Reinforced Riot Exo-Armor
description: Heavy half-plate armor equipped with articulated shoulder and thigh guards for riot control. AC: 15 + Dex modifier (max +2). Medium armor. Stealth: disadvantage.

name: Aegis Heavy Powered Exoskeleton
description: Full-body motorized plate armor that grants immense protection and integrated hydraulic power. AC: 18 (Dex modifier not added). Heavy armor. Stealth: disadvantage. Requires Strength 15 or your speed drops by 10 ft.

name: Hard-Light Riot Shield
description: A wrist-mounted energy projector that creates a solid-state blue barrier against incoming fire. AC: +2 while wielded (Shield). Stacks with body armor; requires one free hand, so it can't be used with two-handed weapons or while both hands are occupied.

name: Bio-Drone Exo-Armor
description: Custom-fitted ceramic and Kevlar armor designed to protect security hounds and combat drones (priced matching base armor type). AC: matches the base armor type it is built from (see the armor above); a drone or hound uses that armor's AC formula.
